title: AI-enhanced breast thermography compared prospectively with mammography
summary: Thermalytix, an AI-based thermal imaging test, was compared with 2-D mammography in 459 women in a prospective, blinded study at one hospital. Against confirmed malignancy (21 cases) it showed sensitivity 95.24% (95% CI 76.18-99.88) and specificity 88.58%; in 168 women with dense breasts sensitivity was 100% with specificity 81.65%. Only 21 malignancies were found, giving wide intervals; the product is commercial and CE-marked. Preprint of 2022-11-30.
